title: Ukrainian data centres and GPU clouds
note: Curated by the OpenNodes project from public sources (ONP-2 §3a). Site-only entries: none of these operators serves models through a public API, so none becomes a node; providers that run models here can name them as facility_operator. During the war each site shows no more than the operator publishes itself (a city, or only the country), never an address. Sites outside Ukraine are not listed here. documented = the operator's own page; claimed = news or third-party pages. Corrections, or removal on request, by pull request or to operators@opennodes.io.
